# session-storage API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Browser storage uses an instance namespace and best-effort JSON persistence.

## useSPFxSessionStorage

Hook to use sessionStorage scoped to SPFx instance

The storage key is automatically scoped to the SPFx instance ID,
ensuring isolation between different web parts/extensions.

Data persists only for the current browser session/tab.

Use for:
- Temporary state
- Session-specific cache
- Tab-specific settings
- Wizard state

Shares local storage's JSON/default/reset and best-effort failure rules. The key uses the same instance namespace; browser per-origin/per-tab session rules determine sharing. Same-document hook instances do not synchronize automatically, and an identical key in another tab is not a shared persistence channel.

### Imports

```ts
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Use when

- JSON workflow state should last only within this browser tab/session for this instance.

### Avoid when

- data must survive the tab/session or be shared with another browser; choose persistent or server storage.

### Throws

- When called outside an SPFx provider.

### Examples

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function WizardComponent() {
  const { value: step, setValue: setStep } = useSPFxSessionStorage('wizard-step', 1);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Step: {step}</p>
      <button onClick={() => setStep(s => s + 1)}>Next</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

#### Save a session draft before clearing it

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface FormData {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
}

function FormWithDraft({ save }: { save: (draft: FormData) => Promise<void> }) {
  const { value: draft, setValue: setDraft } = useSPFxSessionStorage<FormData>('formDraft', {
    title: '',
    description: '',
    category: ''
  });

  const handleChange = (field: keyof FormData, value: string) => {
    setDraft(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    await save(draft);
    setDraft({ title: '', description: '', category: '' }); // Clear draft
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); void handleSubmit().catch(console.error); }}>
      <input
        value={draft.title}
        onChange={e => handleChange('title', e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Title"
      />
      <textarea
        value={draft.description}
        onChange={e => handleChange('description', e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Description"
      />
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
      <p className="hint">Draft auto-saved for this session</p>
    </form>
  );
}
```

#### Resume and complete a session wizard

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface WizardState {
  currentStep: number;
  completedSteps: number[];
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}

function MultiStepWizard() {
  const { value: wizard, setValue: setWizard } = useSPFxSessionStorage<WizardState>('wizard', {
    currentStep: 0,
    completedSteps: [],
    data: {}
  });

  const goToStep = (step: number) => {
    setWizard(prev => ({ ...prev, currentStep: step }));
  };

  const completeStep = (stepData: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    setWizard(prev => ({
      currentStep: prev.currentStep + 1,
      completedSteps: [...prev.completedSteps, prev.currentStep],
      data: { ...prev.data, ...stepData }
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="wizard">
      <nav>
        {[0, 1, 2, 3].map(step => (
          <button
            key={step}
            onClick={() => goToStep(step)}
            disabled={!wizard.completedSteps.includes(step - 1) && step !== 0}
            className={wizard.currentStep === step ? 'active' : ''}
          >
            Step {step + 1}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <main>
        <p>Current step: {wizard.currentStep + 1}</p>
        <button onClick={() => completeStep({ confirmed: true })}>Complete step</button>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Type

```ts
function useSPFxSessionStorage<T>
```

### Signatures

```ts
<T>(key: string, defaultValue: T): SPFxStorageHook<T>
```

#### Type parameters

- `T`: Expected application data shape; no runtime validation is performed.

#### Parameters

- `key`: Storage key (will be prefixed with instance ID)
- `defaultValue`: Fallback when initializing a key or removing its value. Changing it alone preserves the current value; remove uses the latest fallback.

#### Returns

Storage hook with value, setValue, and remove

#### Return shape

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `useSPFxSessionStorage return.remove` | `() => void` | Required, readonly | See [SPFxStorageHook.remove](local-storage.md#spfxstoragehook) | Attempts to delete the scoped storage entry and resets state to the latest defaultValue. Persistence failures are ignored. Inherited from [SPFxStorageHook.remove](local-storage.md#spfxstoragehook). |
| `useSPFxSessionStorage return.setValue` | `(value: T \| ((prev: T) => T)) => void` | Required, readonly | See [SPFxStorageHook.setValue](local-storage.md#spfxstoragehook) | Updates React state and attempts JSON persistence; storage/serialization failures are ignored. Function values are treated as updaters. Inherited from [SPFxStorageHook.setValue](local-storage.md#spfxstoragehook). |
| `useSPFxSessionStorage return.value` | `T` | Required, readonly | See [SPFxStorageHook.value](local-storage.md#spfxstoragehook) | Current value Inherited from [SPFxStorageHook.value](local-storage.md#spfxstoragehook). |
